name: playwright-examples
description: This repo is used to demonstrate various testing scenarios with [Playwright](https://playwright.dev/) 🎭 with node.js

scripts.test:allure: npm run test && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:cucumber:allure: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register -r src/steps/*.ts -r src/support/*.ts --format allure-cucumberjs/reporter && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
